main_page.usb_marker: white short edge of sensor-board rectangle
main_page.view: Fixed-center body in tighter ±0.84 isometric cube; blue screen, violet back, white USB cap, fixed gravity reference and progress marker; no reference ghost in automatic recap

motion.processing: continuous fusion before chart reduction; measured-time gyro integration onto fixed grid
motion.bias: automatic rest and motion gyro bias estimation
motion.orientation: Measured gravity-relative tilt; arbitrary heading reset at onset to camera horizontal axis (+X,+Y); fixed 45-degree display offset only. Comparisons remain onset-relative.
motion.cube: fixed scale ±0.84 display units; full body rotation bound contained
motion.older_references: readable and retained; require a fresh fused reference for comparison
motion.latest_trace: RAM unless selected as stored reference
motion.replay_window: optical onset 0 ms to optical end durationMs; full pre/post capture retained

optical_profile.peak_metric: selected maximum of valid three-consecutive-turn elapsed-time averages (default), or individually validated one-turn peak
optical_profile.human_limit: not asserted; existing detector timing ceiling retained

power.sleep: IMU-only PM1 power hold; ESP32 ext0 G13 fallback if USB retains power
power.wake: BMI270 any-motion on INT1 -> PM1 GPIO4
power.activity: accepted launch, active launch burst, buttons and explicit USB actions; IMU movement/status polling do not extend selected timeout
power.settings_control: Settings: hold B selects Sleep/RPM row; hold A changes/saves selected row; short A next page, short B main

validation.wake_state_tests: both tournament views and all normal pages round-trip; corrupt, removed-view, conflicting and incompatible records rejected
validation.native_tests: motion-replay tests including new interpolated onset/end lookup, sanitizer pass; launch-motion regressions pass
validation.trace_replay: 14 captures: frozen three-turn result/count/burst timestamps and prior single peak values match
validation.runtime: not verified on device for this revision
validation.history: no history schema/settings changes; physical retention check pending next installation
validation.visual_review: Actual MotionUI primitive renders: playback phases, 18 axis/extreme poses, missing/pending states; approximate host fonts, synthetic trace; device review pending

tournament_mode.activation: hold A on main page for 1 second
tournament_mode.new_session_control: hold A on a history page; reference selection unchanged on Motion/Recreate
tournament_mode.persistent: one-shot mode/page snapshot at automatic sleep only; toggles remain RAM-only
tournament_mode.recording_only_style: static red RECORDING ONLY card on black

wake_resume.saved_when: only before automatic sleep, after acquisition stopped and launch/reference data saved
wake_resume.temporary_recap: returns to live; captured motion replay is not written by this change
wake_resume.plain_restart: normal mode when no pending sleep record

rpm_estimators.control_path: frozen three-turn confirmation/slowdown/quiet/rearm for both choices
rpm_estimators.paired_logging: per accepted shot USB LAUNCH_METRICS; not persisted in existing history schema
rpm_estimators.history: original scalar RPM retained, estimator identity unknown for older records
rpm_estimators.session_boundary: on boot and setting change, next accepted pull
